PHP's CVSS 9.2 fixes: Memory exhaustion and stale request state

PHP가 CVSS v4 9.2로 평가된 두 메모리 안전성 취약점(CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619)을 긴급 패치했다. 첫 번째는 메모리 부족(OOM) 발생 시 `zend_bailout()`이 정리 절차를 건너뛰어 미완성 내부 객체가 사용될 수 있는 문제로, 조작된 업로드 요청을 통해 Apache mod_php에서 인증 없이 원격 코드 실행(RCE)으로 이어질 수 있다. 두 번째는 재사용되는 워커가 이전 요청의 해제된 세션·백트레이스 관련 상태를 다음 요청에서 참조할 수 있는 stale request state 문제이며, mod_php와 PHP-FPM에서...

https://jdstaerk.substack.com/p/php-emergency-fix

PHP2Shell Explained: PHP2Shell Was in the Training Data

글은 PHP 코어의 CVE-2026-109618·CVE-2026-109619(통칭 PHP2Shell)가 요청 처리 중 메모리 부족(OOM)과 C의 longjmp 기반 예외 탈출을 악용해 메모리 노출 및 원격 코드 실행으로 이어질 수 있다고 설명합니다. 핵심 원인은 multipart/form-data 파서에서 제한을 우회해 정밀하게 OOM을 유발하고, 그 과정에서 초기화되지 않은 엔트리나 요청 종료 후 남은 전역 dangling pointer를 남기는 것입니다. 영향을 받을 수 있는 공개 PHP 배포 환경은 PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, 8...

https://deadneurons.substack.com/p/php2shell-explained-php2shell-was

What the PHP2Shell rumors got wrong, from inside the PHP security team

PHP 보안팀 관점에서 PHP2Shell 루머와 실제 취약점(CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619)을 대조하며, 핵심 RCE는 기본 설정의 Apache mod_php에서 애플리케이션 코드 실행 전 원격으로 트리거될 수 있다고 설명합니다. 주된 원인은 memory_limit 초과 시 Zend allocator가 longjmp로 요청 초기화 중인 C 코드의 실행을 중단하고, 미완성 상태의 요청 구조체가 shutdown 단계에서 사용되며 발생하는 메모리 손상입니다. 패치된 PHP 8.2.35·8.3.36·8.4.27·8.5.12는 a...

https://daubois.dev/blog/cve-2026-109618-php2shell-rumors/

Cloudflare deploys protections against php2shell vulnerability

PHP 5.4 이상 런타임에 영향을 주는 php2shell(CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619)은 비정상적인 HTTP 요청 처리 중 메모리 초기화·해제 오류를 악용해 서비스 거부, 민감 정보 노출, 원격 코드 실행으로 이어질 수 있는 중대 취약점이다. WordPress와 Magento를 포함해 광범위한 PHP 기반 서비스가 영향을 받을 수 있으며, 공개 전 유출된 뒤 실제 공격 트래픽과 WAF 우회용 페이로드 변형도 관측됐다. Cloudflare는 모든 WAF 플랜에 관리형 탐지를 기본 배포했으며, 요청뿐 아니라 원본 응답까지 같은...

https://blog.cloudflare.com/php-vulnerabilities-waf-protection/

Patch the Planet

OpenAI의 Daybreak 이니셔티브가 Trail of Bits, Calif, HackerOne과 협력해 오픈소스 보안 취약점을 검증·패치·책임 공개하는 프로그램인 ‘Patch the Planet’을 공개했다. 첫 공개 사례인 php2shell은 CVE-2026-109618 및 CVE-2026-109619로 추적되는 PHP의 치명적 취약점으로, 영향받는 서버에서 인증되지 않은 공격자가 원격 코드 실행을 할 수 있다고 설명한다. 유지보수자가 릴리스 통제권을 유지하는 방식으로 패치와 공개를 지원하며, 장기적으로 테스트·퍼징·보안 워크플로도 제공한다. PHP 운영 환경 및 이를 의존하는 AI 서비스는 해당 CVE의 영향 버전과 배포된 패치를 즉시 확인할 필요가 있다.

https://patchtheplanet.org/

#php #security #rce #opensource #vulnerability

Unauthenticated RCE in PHP via stale global state

PHP 엔진의 OOM 처리와 요청 간 전역 상태 정리 결함을 악용하면, 지속 워커를 사용하는 Apache mod_php 및 일부 PHP-FPM 환경에서 인증 없이 원격 코드 실행(RCE)이 가능하다는 보안 분석이다. CVE-2026-109618은 `memory_limit` 초과 시 `longjmp()` 기반 bailout이 반쯤 초기화된 요청 상태를 남기는 문제이고, CVE-2026-109619는 이전 요청 힙을 가리키는 전역 상태가 다음 요청에서 사용되는 use-after-free 문제다. 멀티파트 요청, 세션 업로드 진행률, 요청 초기화 전 적용되는 INI 설정 진단 등이 공격 경로가 될 수 있으며, mod_php에서 HTTP 기반...

posts.content:
PSA: #php2shell gives attackers remote code execution on php servers pre-authentication, and @fastly.com has seen active attack activity.

Here is what you need to know:

* Two critical PHP vulnerabilities disclosed today (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619, CVSS 9.2 

* The root is a decades-old design choice in PHP's error handling (described more in our post)

* There was evidence of in-the-wild exploitation pre-disclosure. 

The potential impact cannot be overstated:
* Breadth: Any organization with PHP applications
* Depth: The attacker can do what they want in the application

We can confirm we have seen attack activity on Fastly's network, including exploitation attempts pre-disclosure.

What to do right now:

The PHP Foundation released patches this morning; we encourage all organizations to patch immediately if they can.

Assume every maintained PHP version is affected. At this time, the oldest demonstrated exploit path has been present since 2012. 

The patches fix the demonstrated exploit paths; the underlying architecture remains vulnerable. Expect novel variants and a ramp-up in exploitation attempts over the next 24 to 48 hours. 

Fastly NGWAF customers should immediately apply the Virtual Patch for CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619 to all services that may be vulnerable.

Our detection content looks for the structural hallmarks of these exploitation attempts that may indicate potential exploitation attempts of php2shell CVEs.

Reach out if Fastly can provide immediate help for you to stay safe: support@fastly.com

Learn more about what’s going on, what to do, what’s next here: https://www.fastly.com/blog/fastlys-proactive-protection-critical-php-rce-cve-2026-109618

https://cyberworldops.eu/en/emergency-php-updates-address-two-critical-rce-flaws-amid-exploitation

PHP2Shell

PHP 코어의 메모리 안전성 취약점군 ‘PHP2Shell’(CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619)이 공개됐으며, CVSS 9.2로 인증 없이 PHP 워커에서 원격 코드 실행(RCE) 또는 프로세스 메모리 유출을 일으킬 수 있습니다. 공격은 WordPress·Drupal·Joomla에 국한되지 않으며, 취약한 PHP 런타임 위의 단순 애플리케이션도 영향을 받을 수 있고 메모리에서 API 키·토큰·비밀번호·인증서가 노출될 수 있습니다. PHP 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27, 8.5.12 이상으로 모든 런타임을 업데이트한 뒤 Apache, PHP-FPM 및 장기 실행 워커를 재시작해야 합니다. 즉시 패치가 불가하면 메모리·입력 크기·워커 재사용을 제한하는 완화책을 검토할 수 있지만, 이는...

https://www.php2shell.com

A tale of two PHP remote vulnerabilities

PHP 5.4.0 이상에 영향을 주는 CVE-2026-109618 및 CVE-2026-109619는 `memory_limit` 초과로 발생한 fatal error가 네이티브 코드의 정리 절차를 중단시키면서, 요청 종료 시 stale 상태를 해제하도록 만들어 원격 코드 실행(RCE)으로 이어질 수 있는 취약점이다. 연구진은 chunked/HTTP2 multipart 요청 또는 중첩된 빈 파일 업로드를 이용해 기본 `post_max_size` 제약 아래에서도 메모리 고갈을 유도하고, 부분 초기화된 HashTable bucket을 teardown이 소비하게 만드는 경로를 제시했다. 기본 구성에서 Apache mod_php 및 일부 PHP-FPM 경로에 신뢰성...

https://calif.io/php2shell.x/

posts.content:
PHP has released emergency fixes for PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619), two critical memory safety flaws in the PHP runtime that can allow unauthenticated code execution.

Upgrade now to 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27, or 8.5.12.

🔗 https://www.endorlabs.com/learn/php2shell-critical-vulnerabilities-in-php-cve-2026-109618-cve-2026-109619

PHP 8.2.35

PHP 8.2.35는 인증 없이 원격 코드 실행이 가능한 치명적 취약점 2건(CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619)을 수정한 보안 릴리스다. 완전한 완화책이 없으며, PHP 8.2을 운영하는 서비스는 즉시 해당 버전 또는 지원되는 최신 PHP 버전으로 업데이트해야 한다. PHP 기반 AI 서비스의 API 서버, 작업 큐 워커, 플러그인·CMS 연동 백엔드도 공격 표면이 될 수 있으므로 이미지 태그, CI 의존성, 런타임 배포 버전을 함께 점검해야 한다. PHP 8.2의 지원은 2026년 12월 31일 종료되므로 장기적으로는 지원 버전으로의 업그레이드 계획이 필요하다.

posts.content:
PSA: #php2shell gives attackers remote code execution on php servers pre-authentication, and @fastly.com has seen active attack activity.

Here is what you need to know:

* Two critical PHP vulnerabilities disclosed today (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619, CVSS 9.2 

* The root is a decades-old design choice in PHP's error handling (described more in our post)

* There was evidence of in-the-wild exploitation pre-disclosure. 

The potential impact cannot be overstated:
* Breadth: Any organization with PHP applications
* Depth: The attacker can do what they want in the application

We can confirm we have seen attack activity on Fastly's network, including exploitation attempts pre-disclosure.

What to do right now:

The PHP Foundation released patches this morning; we encourage all organizations to patch immediately if they can.

Assume every maintained PHP version is affected. At this time, the oldest demonstrated exploit path has been present since 2012. 

The patches fix the demonstrated exploit paths; the underlying architecture remains vulnerable. Expect novel variants and a ramp-up in exploitation attempts over the next 24 to 48 hours. 

Fastly NGWAF customers should immediately apply the Virtual Patch for CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619 to all services that may be vulnerable.

Our detection content looks for the structural hallmarks of these exploitation attempts that may indicate potential exploitation attempts of php2shell CVEs.

Reach out if Fastly can provide immediate help for you to stay safe: support@fastly.com

Learn more about what’s going on, what to do, what’s next here: https://www.fastly.com/blog/fastlys-proactive-protection-critical-php-rce-cve-2026-109618

posts.content:
PHP InfoSec

Wise system administrators who have caught wind of this bug have taken measures already

It hasn't been patched yet but you can mitigate exposure of your systems.
Better yet, do what is written on tweakers.net

Quotes:

Make your store read-only or take it offline

If you can afford to take a PHP server offline for a day, do so. PHP core developer Gina Peter Banyard calls that the most sensible option. Several Dutch sites went offline as a precaution on October 21: tech site Tweakers, the House of Representatives (Tweede Kamer), the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) and security news site Security.NL.

Stop PHP-FPM and have your web server show a static maintenance page. The maintenance modes built into Magento and WordPress do not help: PHP still parses each request before the application checks for the maintenance flag.

If you cannot go offline, make the store read-only. Have your web server reject every request method other than GET and HEAD, for example in nginx:

if ($request_method !~ ^(GET|HEAD)$) {
return 503;
}

Quote:

Websites overnemen

De twee kritieke kwetsbaarheden in PHP (CVE-2026-109618 en CVE-2026-109619) hebben een score van 9,2 op de CVSS v4.0-schaal, die tot 10 gaat. Dat hoge cijfer is gebaseerd op de ernst van een kwetsbaarheid en op hoe makkelijk aanvallers die kunnen misbruiken. De kwetsbaarheden zouden al sinds versie 5.4.0 in PHP zitten, die in maart 2012 uitkwam. Aanvallers kunnen door de kwetsbaarheden eigen webpagina's publiceren. Daardoor kunnen zij mogelijk malware verspreiden. Daarnaast zou de zogeheten PHP2Shell-exploit het mogelijk maken om eigen code uit te voeren op kwetsbare servers.

Volgens verschillende beveiligingsadviezen kan het helpen om session.upload_progress.enabled uit te schakelen. Een bijbehorende tijdelijke oplossing zou zijn om session.use_strict_mode in te schakelen. Beveiligingsexpert Kevin Beaumont meldt dat de Linux-kernelbeveiligingsmodule AppArmor of SELinux ook bescherming biedt tegen misbruik van deze grote PHP-kwetsbaarheden.

I understand the NL language
Translate this if you don't

Jump to the sources read and work

posts.content:
🔧 Dočasně vypínáme podporu přes FreeScout (helpdesk.oscloud.cz) kvůli kritické chybě v PHP. Znovu ji zapneme po aplikování opravy.

⚠️ Kritická zranitelnost v PHP, co to znamená pro OSCloud

PHP tým oznámil dvě kritické chyby (CVE-2026-109618 a CVE-2026-109619, obě CVSS 9.2). Mohou umožnit spuštění cizího kódu na serveru bez přihlášení. Oprava vychází dnes v 16:00 SEČ/CEST. Podle hlášení bezpečnostních firem už probíhají první útoky.

Kterých služeb se to týká:
• Nextcloud, WordPress, Pixelfed, FreeScout, a další aplikace postavené na PHP
• LAMP weby zákazníků (Apache + PHP), včetně těch, kde zatím běží jen úvodní stránka

Kterých ne:
• Mastodon, Matrix, PeerTube, Gitea (PHP nepoužívají)
• Weby a úložiště na statických souborech (Surfer)

Co děláme:
• FreeScout jsme vypnuli
• Další PHP aplikace a LAMP weby budeme vypínat postupně a vždy o tom budeme informovat zde. Počítejte s tím, že dočasně vypneme i Nextcloud, a to do vydání a nasazení opravy
• Jakmile budou dostupné opravené verze aplikací, nasadíme je co nejdřív
• Před vypnutím a updaty děláme zálohy

Co to znamená pro vás:
• Podpora přes FreeScout je do opravy nedostupná
• Nextcloud, LAMP weby a další PHP služby mohou být dnes nedostupné
• Pokud by se při updatu něco pokazilo, vracíme se ze zálohy maximálně 12 hodin zpět

Opravu nelze řešit pluginy ani updatem WordPressu, musí přijít nové PHP v rámci aktualizace aplikace. Pokud provozujete vlastní PHP web mimo OSCloud, aktualizujte PHP hned, jak vyjde oprava.

Děkujeme za trpělivost. Stav budeme průběžně aktualizovat v tomto vlákně.

posts.content:
@pulsar Thanks!

TL;DR: Details of two critical holes in PHP leaked before a fix was ready. They’re in how PHP handles file uploads and could let attackers run their own code on your server. Possibly affects PHP 5 through 8. Fixes are due today at 14:00 UTC, and attacks are expected within minutes of release.

https://www.vincentschmalbach.com/cve-2026-109618-and-cve-2026-109619-what-you-should-do-now/

The bug sits below WordPress or Laravel, so having no upload form doesn’t protect you, and nor do security plugins or maintenance mode.

Until the patch: list every server running PHP, including old staging sites. Switch off PHP’s upload-progress setting, and get your web server to refuse upload-style requests before they reach PHP. That breaks uploads for a few hours, which is the trade-off.

Once the fix lands: update every PHP version on every server, restart PHP and any background workers, and rebuild Docker images. PHP 8.1 and older won’t get a fix, so upgrade or take them offline. On managed hosting, ask your host to confirm.

posts.content:
PSA: #php2shell gives attackers remote code execution on php servers pre-authentication, and @fastly.com has seen active attack activity.

Here is what you need to know:

* Two critical PHP vulnerabilities disclosed today (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619, CVSS 9.2 

* The root is a decades-old design choice in PHP's error handling (described more in our post)

* There was evidence of in-the-wild exploitation pre-disclosure. 

The potential impact cannot be overstated:
* Breadth: Any organization with PHP applications
* Depth: The attacker can do what they want in the application

We can confirm we have seen attack activity on Fastly's network, including exploitation attempts pre-disclosure.

What to do right now:

The PHP Foundation released patches this morning; we encourage all organizations to patch immediately if they can.

Assume every maintained PHP version is affected. At this time, the oldest demonstrated exploit path has been present since 2012. 

The patches fix the demonstrated exploit paths; the underlying architecture remains vulnerable. Expect novel variants and a ramp-up in exploitation attempts over the next 24 to 48 hours. 

Fastly NGWAF customers should immediately apply the Virtual Patch for CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619 to all services that may be vulnerable.

Our detection content looks for the structural hallmarks of these exploitation attempts that may indicate potential exploitation attempts of php2shell CVEs.

Reach out if Fastly can provide immediate help for you to stay safe: support@fastly.com

Learn more about what’s going on, what to do, what’s next here: https://www.fastly.com/blog/fastlys-proactive-protection-critical-php-rce-cve-2026-109618

CISA strongly urges organizations to immediately patch the recently disclosed critical vulnerabilities in PHP, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. Organizations should immediately update to PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, or 8.2.35 to fix these vulnerabilities. While CISA has not observed exploitation of these vulnerabilities as of the time of publication, they pose a risk to organizations if left unpatched.

- On PHP 8.5, set fatal_error_backtraces=0 and restart every worker.
- Fix attacker-reachable fatal errors and execution timeouts, including failures in callbacks, upload or import processing and cleanup.

posts.content:
PSA: #php2shell gives attackers remote code execution on php servers pre-authentication, and @fastly.com has seen active attack activity.

Here is what you need to know:

* Two critical PHP vulnerabilities disclosed today (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619, CVSS 9.2 

* The root is a decades-old design choice in PHP's error handling (described more in our post)

* There was evidence of in-the-wild exploitation pre-disclosure. 

The potential impact cannot be overstated:
* Breadth: Any organization with PHP applications
* Depth: The attacker can do what they want in the application

We can confirm we have seen attack activity on Fastly's network, including exploitation attempts pre-disclosure.

What to do right now:

The PHP Foundation released patches this morning; we encourage all organizations to patch immediately if they can.

Assume every maintained PHP version is affected. At this time, the oldest demonstrated exploit path has been present since 2012. 

The patches fix the demonstrated exploit paths; the underlying architecture remains vulnerable. Expect novel variants and a ramp-up in exploitation attempts over the next 24 to 48 hours. 

Fastly NGWAF customers should immediately apply the Virtual Patch for CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619 to all services that may be vulnerable.

Our detection content looks for the structural hallmarks of these exploitation attempts that may indicate potential exploitation attempts of php2shell CVEs.

Reach out if Fastly can provide immediate help for you to stay safe: support@fastly.com

Learn more about what’s going on, what to do, what’s next here: https://www.fastly.com/blog/fastlys-proactive-protection-critical-php-rce-cve-2026-109618

posts.content:
🚨 Critical pre-authentication RCE research published for two PHP core vulnerabilities; CVE-2026-109618 + CVE-2026-109619

PoC: https://github.com/ikow/php2shell-poc

The flaws affect PHP's session.upload_progress handling and can be chained through session-file injection, memory corruption, or deserialization behavior to achieve remote code execution under specific application conditions.

CVSS: 9.2 Critical
Affected: PHP 5.4.0 through 8.5.11
Fixed: PHP 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27, and 8.5.12

The repository includes verification PoCs for session injection, a heap use-after-free, and handler-mismatch deserialization, along with a vulnerable Docker lab and detailed technical analysis.

posts.content:
PHP InfoSec

Wise system administrators who have caught wind of this bug have taken measures already

It hasn't been patched yet but you can mitigate exposure of your systems.
Better yet, do what is written on tweakers.net

Quotes:

Make your store read-only or take it offline

If you can afford to take a PHP server offline for a day, do so. PHP core developer Gina Peter Banyard calls that the most sensible option. Several Dutch sites went offline as a precaution on October 21: tech site Tweakers, the House of Representatives (Tweede Kamer), the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) and security news site Security.NL.

Stop PHP-FPM and have your web server show a static maintenance page. The maintenance modes built into Magento and WordPress do not help: PHP still parses each request before the application checks for the maintenance flag.

If you cannot go offline, make the store read-only. Have your web server reject every request method other than GET and HEAD, for example in nginx:

if ($request_method !~ ^(GET|HEAD)$) {
return 503;
}

Quote:

Websites overnemen

De twee kritieke kwetsbaarheden in PHP (CVE-2026-109618 en CVE-2026-109619) hebben een score van 9,2 op de CVSS v4.0-schaal, die tot 10 gaat. Dat hoge cijfer is gebaseerd op de ernst van een kwetsbaarheid en op hoe makkelijk aanvallers die kunnen misbruiken. De kwetsbaarheden zouden al sinds versie 5.4.0 in PHP zitten, die in maart 2012 uitkwam. Aanvallers kunnen door de kwetsbaarheden eigen webpagina's publiceren. Daardoor kunnen zij mogelijk malware verspreiden. Daarnaast zou de zogeheten PHP2Shell-exploit het mogelijk maken om eigen code uit te voeren op kwetsbare servers.

Volgens verschillende beveiligingsadviezen kan het helpen om session.upload_progress.enabled uit te schakelen. Een bijbehorende tijdelijke oplossing zou zijn om session.use_strict_mode in te schakelen. Beveiligingsexpert Kevin Beaumont meldt dat de Linux-kernelbeveiligingsmodule AppArmor of SELinux ook bescherming biedt tegen misbruik van deze grote PHP-kwetsbaarheden.

I understand the NL language
Translate this if you don't

Jump to the sources read and work

Sources:

https://sansec.io/research/php2shell

https://tweakers.net/

🚨 If you run PHP (like most of the internet does), this one can’t wait: #PHP2Shell = 2 critical RCE flaws in PHP core leaked before the patch, with live attacks already reported.

Because CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619 sit in PHP itself, every app on a vulnerable PHP version is exposed, no matter what runs on top.

That’s why we’re building detection in our Network Scanner + an exploit module in Sniper as you’re reading this. Stay tuned for the launch announcement!

What to do now:

Inventory every PHP install, including control panels, vendor appliances, and Windows software that bundles its own php-cgi.exe
Patch as soon as PHP’s release is out, then restart PHP-FPM or your web server
On PHP 8.1 or older? No fix is coming. Upgrade, or take those systems off the internet
Alert on PHP processes spawning shells, interpreters, or download tools

posts.content:
🔧 Dočasně vypínáme podporu přes FreeScout (helpdesk.oscloud.cz) kvůli kritické chybě v PHP. Znovu ji zapneme po aplikování opravy.

⚠️ Kritická zranitelnost v PHP, co to znamená pro OSCloud

PHP tým oznámil dvě kritické chyby (CVE-2026-109618 a CVE-2026-109619, obě CVSS 9.2). Mohou umožnit spuštění cizího kódu na serveru bez přihlášení. Oprava vychází dnes v 16:00 SEČ/CEST. Podle hlášení bezpečnostních firem už probíhají první útoky.

Kterých služeb se to týká:
• Nextcloud, WordPress, Pixelfed, FreeScout, a další aplikace postavené na PHP
• LAMP weby zákazníků (Apache + PHP), včetně těch, kde zatím běží jen úvodní stránka

Kterých ne:
• Mastodon, Matrix, PeerTube, Gitea (PHP nepoužívají)
• Weby a úložiště na statických souborech (Surfer)

Co děláme:
• FreeScout jsme vypnuli
• Další PHP aplikace a LAMP weby budeme vypínat postupně a vždy o tom budeme informovat zde. Počítejte s tím, že dočasně vypneme i Nextcloud, a to do vydání a nasazení opravy
• Jakmile budou dostupné opravené verze aplikací, nasadíme je co nejdřív
• Před vypnutím a updaty děláme zálohy

Co to znamená pro vás:
• Podpora přes FreeScout je do opravy nedostupná
• Nextcloud, LAMP weby a další PHP služby mohou být dnes nedostupné
• Pokud by se při updatu něco pokazilo, vracíme se ze zálohy maximálně 12 hodin zpět

Opravu nelze řešit pluginy ani updatem WordPressu, musí přijít nové PHP v rámci aktualizace aplikace. Pokud provozujete vlastní PHP web mimo OSCloud, aktualizujte PHP hned, jak vyjde oprava.

Děkujeme za trpělivost. Stav budeme průběžně aktualizovat v tomto vlákně.

#OSCloud #PHP #Bezpečnost

posts.content:
@pulsar Thanks!

TL;DR: Details of two critical holes in PHP leaked before a fix was ready. They’re in how PHP handles file uploads and could let attackers run their own code on your server. Possibly affects PHP 5 through 8. Fixes are due today at 14:00 UTC, and attacks are expected within minutes of release.

https://www.vincentschmalbach.com/cve-2026-109618-and-cve-2026-109619-what-you-should-do-now/

The bug sits below WordPress or Laravel, so having no upload form doesn’t protect you, and nor do security plugins or maintenance mode.

Until the patch: list every server running PHP, including old staging sites. Switch off PHP’s upload-progress setting, and get your web server to refuse upload-style requests before they reach PHP. That breaks uploads for a few hours, which is the trade-off.

Once the fix lands: update every PHP version on every server, restart PHP and any background workers, and rebuild Docker images. PHP 8.1 and older won’t get a fix, so upgrade or take them offline. On managed hosting, ask your host to confirm.

posts.content:
Critical FortiSIEM gRPC Flaw Allows Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution

Fortinet patched a critical path traversal vulnerability (CVE-2026-106173) in FortiSIEM that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by overwriting system scripts via a gRPC service.

**If you run FortiSIEM on-premise (versions 7.0 through 7.5.0), upgrade to 7.5.1 or later right away. A working exploit is already public, so treat this as an emergency. Until you can patch, block TCP port 27918 for everything except trusted management networks, and check whether `/opt/charting/redishb.sh` or `/opt/phoenix/bin/phLicenseTool` has been modified.**
#cybersecurity #infosec #advisory #vulnerability
https://beyondmachines.net/event_details/critical-fortisiem-grpc-flaw-allows-unauthenticated-remote-code-execution-b-w-l-1-m/gD2P6Ple2L

CVE-2026-106173.description: A improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('path traversal') vulnerability in Fortinet FortiSIEM 7.5.0 may allow attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specially crafted packets.

CVE-2026-76466.description:
A vulnerability in the database service feature of Cisco Expressway Series could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker with network access to a Cisco Expressway device to execute arbitrary operating system commands as root.

This vulnerability is due to the use of persistent cookies. Additionally, there is insufficient validation of client certificates when the TLS Verify Mode is set to Enabled for clustering, which means that client certificates are not validated. An attacker with possession of the cookies could exploit this vulnerability by connecting to the database service and invoking specific remote procedure call (RPC) commands. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root on the underlying operating system of an affected device.
Note: Cisco Expressway Series refers to Cisco Expressway Core (Expressway-C) devices and Cisco Expressway Edge (Expressway-E) devices.

CVE-2026-99999.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ipv4: validate checksum_start before completing checksum

If a packet with bad checksum metadata gets into the ipv4 stack,
skb_checksum_help can corrupt the network header and cause a bunch of
mischief.

This was discovered and reported by Paulos, and has been reporoduced
by others independently since.

We really shouldn't allow such packets in, but as a defence
in depth measure, let's also check before we complete the checksum.

A more complete validation at input is forthcoming, but needs more work.

CVE-2025-54068 : Deep Dive Into Livewire, From Weak Typing To Pre-Authenticated Remote Command Execution - Rémi Matasse
#HackLu @hack_lu

CVE-2025-54068.description:
### Impact
In Livewire v3 (≤ 3.6.3), a vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote command execution in specific scenarios. The issue stems from how certain component property updates are hydrated. This vulnerability is unique to Livewire v3 and does not affect prior major versions. Exploitation requires a component to be mounted and configured in a particular way, but does not require authentication or user interaction.

### Patches
This issue has been patched in Livewire v3.6.4. All users are strongly encouraged to upgrade to this version or later as soon as possible.

### Workarounds
There is no known workaround at this time. Users are strongly advised to upgrade to a patched version immediately.

### Resources
No public references available at this time to avoid exposure. Details will be published after a responsible disclosure window.

🚨 Security update: Unbound 1.26.2 is now available.

This release consolidates security fixes for issues reported over a period of time. There are fixes for CVE-2026-35501, CVE-2026-50106, CVE-2026-96405, CVE-2026-97206 and CVE-2026-109125.

https://community.nlnetlabs.nl/t/unbound-1-26-2-released/3495

#DNS #OpenSource #Security #CVE

CVE-2026-35501.description: When NLnet Labs Unbound 1.0.1 up to and including version 1.26.1 is configured with both a root trust anchor and an additional 'trust-anchor:' for an island-of-security zone whose parent is provably insecure under the root chain, a malicious actor with a forged NSEC reply with the SOA bit cleared can trick Unbound to treat the configured trust island as insecure. This happens because the DNSSEC validator in Unbound accepts and caches the NSEC insecure response bypassing the RRSIG validation that the validator was supposed to do. The acceptance of the NSEC record at the trust anchor apex was allowed due to and old fix for type DS and NSEC queries from clients when trust anchor for that name existed.

A client-triggered QUIC path migration can enter stream/connection cleanup while a mesh reply still retains a pointer to the DoQ stream. CVE-2026-109125.description: In NLnet Labs Unbound up to and including version 1.26.1, an observable  cache-level side-channel can be exposed with 'unwanted-reply-threshold > 0' configurations (not a default configuration). If a response-like UDP datagram reaches the upstream source port currently used by a recursive query, but its TXID does not match any pending query, Unbound counts the packet as an unwanted reply. When the accumulated count reaches the configured threshold, Unbound clears the worker's RRset cache and message cache. This cache clear action does not destroy the current upstream UDP pending query. Therefore, an external observer can distinguish whether a candidate port matches the current upstream source port by checking whether an existing cached item has been cleared. This is a cache side-channel vulnerability that can be used to probe the upstream source port. Although the attack is not feasible on default configurations and the suggested value (10 million) makes it an ureliable attack on a public resolver, in scenarios where the attacker can keep a concurrent query window alive, the attacker can first filter the source port and then perform birthday-style guessing against the TXID, making cache poisoning a feasible attack path.

posts.content: CVE-2026-71195 (CRITICAL, CVSS 9.9) impacts OpenStack Manila <23.0.1: incorrect authorization lets any authenticated user manipulate public shares’ access, data, and metadata. Patch immediately. https://radar.offseq.com/threat/cve-2026-71195-cwe-863-incorrect-authorization-in-openstack-manila-18015d0d3bd42f24 #OffSeq #OpenStack #Vuln #Infosec

CVE-2026-71195.description: In OpenStack Manila before 23.0.1, multiple Manila API operations on public shares do not verify that the caller owns the share. The API controllers authorize operations against the caller's own project context, then load a foreign public share without re-authorizing against the share's actual owner. This affects the following operations: allow_access: grant data-plane read/write access to another tenant's share; deny_access: revoke the owner's existing access rules; update_access: escalate access level (e.g., ro to rw); create_share_backup: exfiltrate share data via a backup created under the attacker's project; soft_delete: move a foreign share to the recycle bin; restore: interfere with the owner's deletion workflow; export location metadata: create, update, and delete metadata on foreign export locations; access rule listing: disclose IPs, usernames, and CephFS keys. Any authenticated project member can exploit these operations on any public share. The share UUID is visible since the share is public.

posts.content: @mcc https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/cve-2025-69420

CVE-2025-69420.description:
Issue summary: A type confusion vulnerability exists in the TimeStamp Response
verification code where an ASN1_TYPE union member is accessed without first
validating the type, causing an invalid or NULL pointer dereference when
processing a malformed TimeStamp Response file.

Impact summary: An application calling TS_RESP_verify_response() with a
malformed TimeStamp Response can be caused to dereference an invalid or
NULL pointer when reading, resulting in a Denial of Service.

The functions ossl_ess_get_signing_cert() and ossl_ess_get_signing_cert_v2()
access the signing cert attribute value without validating its type.
When the type is not V_ASN1_SEQUENCE, this results in accessing invalid memory
through the ASN1_TYPE union, causing a crash.

Exploiting this vulnerability requires an attacker to provide a malformed
TimeStamp Response to an application that verifies timestamp responses. The
TimeStamp protocol (RFC 3161) is not widely used and the impact of the
exploit is just a Denial of Service. For these reasons the issue was
assessed as Low severity.

The FIPS modules in 3.5, 3.4, 3.3 and 3.0 are not affected by this issue,
as the TimeStamp Response implementation is outside the OpenSSL FIPS module
boundary.

OpenSSL 3.6, 3.5, 3.4, 3.3, 3.0 and 1.1.1 are vulnerable to this issue.

OpenSSL 1.0.2 is not affected by this issue.

CVE-2026-92262.description: MariaDB server is a community developed fork of MySQL server. From 10.6.1 until 10.6.28, 10.11.19, 11.4.13, 11.8.9, 12.3.3, and 13.0.2, the #mysql50# bypass prefix is affected because it allows the #mysql50# prefix to bypass normal table-name filesystem encoding. An attacker can trigger the issue with a table name using the #mysql50# prefix, then use a #mysql50# table name to access files under their legacy unencoded name and cause crashes, data corruption, data exfiltration, or remote code execution. This issue is fixed in versions 10.6.28, 10.11.19, 11.4.13, 11.8.9, 12.3.3, and 13.0.2.

posts.content: Your NGINX installation may already be a smoldering crater — but the good news is F5 has heroically issued out-of-band patches, which is vendor-speak for "we skipped the normal schedule because yikes." Three critical flaws across ngx_http_v3_module and the NGINX map directive — CVE-2026-15176, CVE-2026-97205, and CVE-2026-93479 — let unauthenticated remote attackers trigger heap buffer overflows, run arbitrary code, or knock your server flat. (2/4)

CVE-2026-97205.description:
NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source have a vulnerability in the ngx_http_core_module module. When asynchronous file I/O (AIO) is enabled in certain configurations, processing a Server Side Includes (SSI) page containing “include virtual” commands may trigger a Use-After-Free (UAF) in the NGINX worker process. This may cause memory corruption or a worker process crash. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR.

Impact:
This vulnerability may allow remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the NGINX system, corrupt its memory, or possibly trigger code execution. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.




Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

A vulnerability exists in NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source when a location is configured that uses the alias directive together with rewrite and a set or return directive referencing the $request_filename variable. An unauthenticated attacker along with conditions beyond their control can exploit this vulnerability by sending crafted HTTP requests. This may cause a heap buffer overflow in the NGINX worker process leading to a restart. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR.

Impact:
This vulnerability may allow remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the NGINX system or to possibly trigger a code execution. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.




Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.
